basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer from Milan, Italy, who recently got interested in cryptocurrencies and personal finance. My main hobbies include motorcycling, especially with my Honda Rebel 300, and gaming, with a particular fondness for narrative-driven games like Kena: Bridge of Spirits. I work full-time for a tech startup and am single. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work around 8-11 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having obtained my degree from Politecnico di Milano. My interest in cryptocurrencies was sparked by reading articles online and discussions in finance-related subreddits. I am still learning and rely on community advice and online resources to navigate this new area.
